_source: Story 054, decision D-062 (stones: D-064). How a room's ground is built by GroundDresser (src/world/ground_dresser.gd). 'default' applies to every theme; a theme's own block (keys from data/world/themes.json) overrides single keys. margin_cells: rock drawn around the room (cells) so a zoomed-out camera never shows a void past the room's edge. shade: darkness laid over solid rock by distance from open air in cells (index 0 = the surface, the last value for anything deeper). shade_z: how far in front of the rock face that darkness sits. top_shade: darkness on the rock top behind the walkable slabs, [front, back]. cap_back_z: how far back the walkable slabs reach (play plane z 0, rock face z 1.2). slab_len: slab lengths (m); chip_chance: share of slabs with a broken front; slab_cut: how much a slab's top corners are knocked off (m). stone: the material every face stone is cut from; tints: the colours stones are picked from, one per stone, so no two neighbours match; tint_jitter: extra brightness spread. style: 'masonry' (courses of cut stone, two per metre) or 'rock' (rough chunks, one per metre). stone_w: stone widths (m); stone_cut: corner chipping (m); stone_out: how far a stone stands out of the face (m); skin_cells: how deep into the rock stones are laid (deeper is in darkness anyway); missing: share of stones fallen out. stains_every / cracks_every: water stains running down from an edge and cracks in the face (m between them). clutter_every: metres between pieces of clutter on a walkable top; clutter: weights of what lies there (candles, skull, bones, rubble, stub = a broken column, grave). accent: what hangs off or runs along the edge ('moss', 'roots' with glowing drips, 'gold' moulding, 'embers' in the joints), accent_every its spacing (m). teeth_every / teeth_len: rock teeth under every overhang (m), at most teeth_room of the free space below. pebbles_every: loose stones on the lip (m).
